durationRule: Use the ElevenLabs scene voiceover duration and round up to the next whole second.

scenes.imagePrompt: Rome's city gate at dusk in portrait framing, towering walls rising vertically, barbarian campfires far outside, but the foreground Roman guard turns his worried face back toward the city behind him.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera pushes past the guard toward the gate as he slowly turns inward, torch smoke curling upward and distant fires flickering outside the walls.

scenes.imagePrompt: A Roman barracks courtyard packed with soldiers, shields stacked high along both sides, one veteran steps forward from the crowd as others close ranks behind him.
scenes.videoPrompt: Soldiers shift into a tight formation around the viewer, shields clatter, a veteran steps into foreground, banners whipping overhead.

scenes.imagePrompt: A young emperor in a marble throne hall caught between senators on one side and armored officers on the other, both groups leaning toward him like competing walls.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera circles the emperor as senators gesture and officers step closer, the throne looming behind him while sunlight slides across marble.

scenes.imagePrompt: A solemn old senator presenting ancestral wax masks and scrolls to a nervous emperor, tall shelves of family busts rising into shadow above them.
scenes.videoPrompt: The senator lifts a scroll toward the emperor while dust floats in sunbeams and ancestral masks seem to watch from the darkness.

scenes.imagePrompt: Cold frontier command tent, year 235 implied by Roman campaign gear, Severus Alexander bends over maps as wind pulls open the tent flap revealing restless troops outside.
scenes.videoPrompt: Wind bursts through the tent, maps flutter, the emperor pins them down while silhouettes of soldiers gather outside.

scenes.imagePrompt: Severus Alexander offering gold bowls and treaty gifts to Germanic envoys across a rough table, furious Roman officers standing behind him in tight vertical formation.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gold changes hands across the table as Roman officers tense behind him, one officer steps forward, mist rolling through the frontier camp.

scenes.imagePrompt: Battle-hardened Roman soldiers around a low campfire at night, faces angry and wounded, one soldier rises with his sword while others follow his movement.
scenes.videoPrompt: Sparks rise as soldiers stand one by one, hands gripping sword hilts, the camera tilts up with them toward the emperor's tent.

scenes.imagePrompt: The imperial tent at night, soldiers rushing through torn red fabric, lamplight swinging, maps and coins scattering across the floor, violence implied but not graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Soldiers burst into the tent, fabric tears, a lamp swings wildly, maps fly across the frame as the camera stumbles backward.

scenes.imagePrompt: Maximinus Thrax in portrait heroic framing, a huge muddy frontier soldier lifted visually above the crowd, rough cloak and scarred armor, troops roaring beneath him.
scenes.videoPrompt: Soldiers surge around Maximinus, lifting shields and spears, his cloak snaps in the wind as the camera rises from boots to face.

scenes.imagePrompt: A legion raising a new emperor on shields in a military camp, vertical forest of spears around him, distant Rome reduced to a hazy marble memory far below.
scenes.videoPrompt: The shield rises through the crowd, spears thrust upward in waves, camera cranes up with the new emperor over cheering soldiers.

scenes.imagePrompt: Multiple ambitious generals in separate campfires suggested in one cinematic scene: foreground general reaches for a purple cloak while other torchlit figures mirror him in depth.
scenes.videoPrompt: The foreground general grabs imperial purple as background commanders turn toward their own troops, torches flaring in sequence through the camp.

scenes.imagePrompt: A brutal army payday: coin sacks dumped onto a wooden table beside a purple cloak and imperial standard, soldiers' hands reaching in from every side.
scenes.videoPrompt: Coins spill and bounce across the table, hands snatch purses, the purple cloak slides toward the soldiers like something being sold.

scenes.imagePrompt: Praetorian corridor at night, emperor walking away from camera, guards behind him drawing closer, tall lamps and columns creating a narrowing tunnel.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera tracks behind the emperor as guards close the distance, lamplight flickers across armor, shadows stretch along the marble floor.

scenes.imagePrompt: Rome's marketplace still beautiful but tense, aqueduct arches above, citizens freeze as armed soldiers march straight through the center, interrupting daily life.
scenes.videoPrompt: Soldiers march through the crowd, citizens step aside, cloth awnings ripple, camera follows a child watching the troops pass.

scenes.imagePrompt: Portrait vertical travel shot of Roman power still functioning: road below, aqueduct above, tax clerks and marching troops layered upward through the frame under heavy clouds.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera glides upward from road stones to aqueduct arches as troops march below, tax papers flutter, storm clouds moving overhead.

scenes.imagePrompt: Empty imperial throne in a dim hall, helmet on one side, senator's scroll on the other, dust glowing in a shaft of light, no ruler present.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push toward the empty throne as dust swirls in golden light, a helmet rolls slightly, the hall settling into silence.
